C0808.title: 2022 npm Ecosystem wsrcsv Backdoor Trojan Distribution Incident
C0808.summary: Qi An Xin Star Map Lab's annual review reported that on October 2, 2022, the Tianwen platform found npm user nsrvmzuq had uploaded 152 malicious packages with names similar to popular packages. During installation, the packages ran scripts that downloaded a Windows shortcut, then fetched VBS code and the wsrcsv.exe backdoor, mainly affecting Windows users who installed the typosquatted packages.

references.title: Tianwen: 2022 Annual Review of npm Ecosystem Software Supply Chain Attacks | Star Map Lab
